When Anne Shirley and Diana Barry accidentally stumbled upon Echo Lodge, Charlotta served them biscuits and demonstrated the local echoes. She later confided in Anne about her deep concerns regarding Miss Lavendar's declining health and spirits, including an incident where she accidentally broke a cherished heirloom bowl without receiving any scolding. Upon learning that Stephen Irving was coming to reunite with Miss Lavendar, Charlotta was overjoyed, secretly watching him from the kitchen window. On the wedding day, she dressed in her finest attire and watched the ceremony proceed smoothly.
